title: Full-Density Degenerate Stagnation Points for Water Waves with General Vorticity
summary: In this paper, we revisit the singular asymptotics of the free surface near stagnation points for two-dimensional traveling gravity water waves with vorticity. We prove the nonexistence of full-density degenerate stagnation points beyond the strict two-sided linear growth regime. Our main tools are a modified Weiss-type monotonicity formula and a modified Almgren-type frequency formula.
